item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

turns.text: I'd like to get this wide photo ready to share. I've been second-guessing how it will look once I post it. What I need is to make this pic square for an Instagram post. Please keep the whole sneaker in view, without stretching it. Other than making it square, don't change anything else.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the square version because Magic Hour refused the edit due to insufficient credits. No image was made.

To preserve the photo exactly, use a **square canvas with padding**, not a crop:
- Set the canvas to **512 × 512 px**.
- Center the original **512 × 307 px** photo without resizing.
- Add **102 px above and 103 px below**, using white or light-gray padding.

This keeps the whole sneaker visible without stretching or changing anything in the original photo.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make this landscape product photo square ONLY by adding plain neutral light-gray padding equally above and below the original photo. Preserve the entire original rectangular photograph unchanged in the center, including the whole sneaker and all original background details. Do not crop any part of the original photo. Do not stretch, distort, retouch, relight, clean up, replace, or otherwise alter the shoe or original background. Keep the original aspect ratio of the photograph. Only expand the canvas to 1:1 with solid neutral light-gray top and bottom borders; no other changes.

approvals.reason: insufficient credits (dry run: this run makes nothing; the attempted call is recorded)

denied: edit_image: insufficient credits (dry run: this run makes nothing; the attempted call is recorded)
